outcome: reproductive outcomes (conception rate, full-term live birth rate)
cohort: 44 women with cervical adenocarcinoma in situ (AIS) who underwent LEEP as initial treatment, with a mean age at diagnosis of 36.1 years.
finding: LEEP with negative surgical margins was found to be a safe, feasible, and fertility-sparing surgical procedure for patients with AIS, resulting in satisfactory obstetric outcomes.
